survey: A jack-o'-lantern sits on a wooden plank tabletop in front of a purple sunburst background. The camera is a little above the table. The planks run roughly left to right, get wider toward the viewer and recede toward a back edge that is nearly horizontal. The pumpkin is a wide, ribbed squashed sphere. Its ribs curve over the top and meet at a green stem, and because a sliver of the top surface shows behind the stem, the pumpkin agrees with the table's raised viewpoint. Its flattened bottom rests on the planks, and its contact shadow falls back and to the right, so it sits flat on the table plane. The carved face (two triangle eyes and a zigzag mouth) is on the front of the pumpkin, facing the camera.

errors.where: Carved face (eyes and mouth), especially the left and right ends of the mouth
errors.what: The face is drawn like a flat front-facing sticker and does not wrap around the round, ribbed body. The ends of the mouth come close to the side edges of the pumpkin, where the surface turns sharply away. They should get narrower and bend around the form there, but they stay full height and evenly spaced. The cut edges also do not bend where they cross the rib grooves.

fix: Carve the jack-o'-lantern face so it wraps around the curved pumpkin: the eyes and mouth follow the curve of the ribs, the ends of the mouth get narrower and bend away toward the sides of the pumpkin, and the cut edges show the thickness of the rind and dip slightly where they cross the rib grooves.
